title: Customer sessions
lede: Every sale at a rule-engine store is a customer session at HQ. Read one's calls and the budget movements they caused, its cart and what each campaign did, or cancel it to roll them back.

filter.storesFailed: The store list could not be read.
filter.storesDenied: The store list is the campaign builder's, and you do not hold its grant.

lookup.label: Or look one up by its sale id

results.needsStore: Choose a store to list its sessions, or look one up by its sale id.
results.capped: HQ answers the newest <n>{{n}}</n> only: narrow by status.
results.failed: HQ did not answer the sessions list.
results.denied: You do not hold the support grant to read customer sessions (RuleSupport, display).

detail.failed: HQ did not answer for this sale id.
detail.denied: You do not hold the support grant to read customer sessions (RuleSupport, display).

events.none: HQ holds no call for this session.

reason.expiredHold: A hold expired before close and its commit passed the limit
reason.loweredLimit: The limit was lowered below what the counter holds
reason.confirmedResult: A late close counted a confirmed result past the limit
reason.lateEarnRefused: A late close's points were refused by the budget
reason.createdCouponUsed: The coupon this sale created was used before its return

budgetEvent.figures: Budget <v>{{budget}}</v>: wanted <v>{{desired}}</v>, given <v>{{awarded}}</v>, used <v>{{used}}</v> against a limit of <v>{{limit}}</v>

cart.none: HQ holds no cart for this session.

campaigns.none: No campaign touched this session, and HQ refused it nothing.
campaigns.holdReleased: Held <v>{{amount}}</v> of budget <v>{{budget}}</v>, released when it expired (close still counts it)

cancel.title: Cancel session
cancel.bodyPaying: Session <v>{{saleId}}</v> is paying: HQ releases every budget it holds and it goes to Cancelled.
cancel.bodyReturn: Session <v>{{saleId}}</v> has closed: HQ returns every unit still out — budgets back, the coupon refunded, the codes it created disabled when unused, the points given back — and it goes to Returned.
cancel.reasonHint: Required. HQ keeps it with the cancel. <v>{{n}}</v> of <v>{{max}}</v> characters.
cancel.reasonRequired: Say why the session is cancelled.
cancel.reasonTooLong: At most <v>{{max}}</v> characters: this reason has <v>{{n}}</v>.
cancel.reasonKept: HQ may have taken that press: pressing again retries it as it was, reason included, and HQ answers it once.
cancel.refusedTitle: HQ did not cancel the session
cancel.denied: You do not hold the support grant to cancel a session (RuleSupport, change).

refusal.RULES_SESSION_CANCELLED: The session is already cancelled. It is read afresh.
refusal.RULES_SESSION_CLOSED: Every unit of the sale is already returned: nothing is left to undo. It is read afresh.
refusal.RULES_SESSION_OPEN: The session never paid, so it holds nothing to cancel. It is read afresh.
refusal.RULES_REQUEST_ID_REUSED: HQ already answered this press under another call. Press again to send a new one.
refusal.RULES_REASON_REQUIRED: HQ needs a reason for the cancel.
refusal.RULES_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: HQ holds no session for this sale id.

rollback.title: HQ cancelled the session; it is now {{state}}. It rolled back:
rollback.repeatedTitle: HQ had already cancelled the session; it is {{state}}.
rollback.repeated: This press repeated one HQ had already answered: nothing moved now.
